arms.description: Run the direct lfdclose2 D4 closure on the SHA-pinned independently reconstructed 51-generator text input.

claims.text: The direct fixed-point computation gives the exact rank of W4 on the fixed 51-variable sliced system, to compare with the checked seed-kernel dimension 226437.

aa.not_applicable_reason: One deterministic exact rank calculation; no timing comparison.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Fixed named equations and exact rank; no sampled null population.

positive.not_applicable_reason: The direct fixed-point program was previously used for named D3 certificates; this input identity is checked termwise, and no statistical detector is involved.

decision_rule.text: Only a successful fixed-point termination with W4_one=0 and rank 226437 can establish equality of the direct closure dimension and checked seed kernel dimension. A smaller rank shows the checked seed is coarse; timeout, OOM or malformed output leaves exactness unknown. No result alone upgrades the LFD bound.
decision_rule.threshold: Exact rank equality to 226437 with W4_one=0

placement.checkpoint_detail: Queue behind the existing n51 D5 owner lock; one direct D4 run, no checkpoint or automatic retry. Preserve all failures and stdout/stderr.

inadmissible: Inferring D5 correctness or LFD>=6 from a D4 control.
Calling a native checker qualified if status or any exact field differs.
Retrying after failure or timeout under this one-attempt protocol.
invalidation_rules: Any source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure prevents a solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing later stages remain unknown, even if an earlier stage proves a smaller lower bound.
Deferred export or missing checkpoint/certificate carries no mathematical bound.
Restore request mismatch or unverified state prevents native launch.

literature.claim: A checked quotient proves W4 containment in its kernel; equality needs a reverse rank witness.
Direct rank 226437 is the equality target for this fixed n51 slice.
